name: r8_finisher_retune_on_oof
author: first_agent
entrant_decision: 2026-09-30: give the finisher re-tuning on the 400 OOF shots a chance
question: Is there a finisher setting better than v25's, measured honestly on shots the networks never saw, with the selection itself cross-validated?
data: the 5 K-fold OOF folds (400 training shots; each fold's 16 networks never saw it), every 2nd frame, scored with the organisers' reading (as reeval/r2_stage_attribution.py)
selection: nested over folds: for each held-out fold j, the variant with the highest pooled S on the other four folds is chosen and scored on fold j; the nested estimate is the pooled S of the 400 shots under these per-fold choices minus V0
uncertainty: 20000-resample shot bootstrap of the nested difference (seed 930)
acceptance: nested dS >= +0.00002 and P(dS > 0) >= 0.9; then the variant chosen on all 400 shots goes into the next public build
